status: provisional: keys chosen by PIXEL pending FORGE's audio manifest; rename via the keys only
notes: Paths are relative to basePath (public/audio/ in the repo; import.meta.env.BASE_URL + 'audio/' at runtime).
Looping assets: decode with Web Audio and set source.loop=true, source.loopStart=loopStartSec, source.loopEnd=loopEndSec.
Do not loop music/ambience with HTMLAudioElement.loop: it plays the pre/post-roll and is not gapless on Safari.

Levels: music -18 LUFS integrated, ambience -30 LUFS, SFX normalised by loudest 100 ms window (-16 dB; UI -21, dialogue -23, footsteps -33 (path -34) via footsteps.py); music <= -1.5 dBTP, SFX <= -3 dBTP.
